openAsApp: Open Murmur as an app (npm run tauri dev) to record.
englishModelMissing: To record in English, download the English model.
deleteMessageWithAudio: The transcript, notes and saved audio of “{{title}}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
deleteMessage: The transcript and notes of “{{title}}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
coverNeedsModel: Turn on the summary in Settings › Intelligence and download the model.
coverNeedsKey: Connect the account in Settings › Intelligence to generate the summary.
coverAfterRecording: It can be generated once the recording ends.
missingModelBody: Murmur transcribes with a model that runs on this Mac. You only need to download it once.
emptyBody: Record a meeting and the transcript will appear live, split by speaker. Everything is processed on this Mac: local means private.
consentReminder: Remember to ask participants for their consent.
exportScreensTitle: Choose where to save the screenshots
retranscribeLabel: Whisper listens to the audio again in:
retranscribeMessage: Whisper will listen to the recording again and write every line in {{language}}. Who spoke and when stays the same, and so do lines you corrected by hand. It will take about {{minutes}} min, and then the summary is made again if you have it on.
retranscribeNeedsWhisper: Transcribing again needs the Whisper model.
importWhileRecording: Stop recording before opening an audio file.
dropTitle: Drop the file to transcribe it
dropFormats: mp3, m4a, wav, ogg, mp4 and more. Murmur works out the language by itself.
dropLater: It will start once the current recording or transcription is done.
importLanguage: Language: {{language}}. If that's wrong, you can transcribe it again in another one when it's done.
importLanguageUnclear: Couldn't tell the language. Transcribing in your usual one: {{language}}.
